top_choice_rationale: The narrowly framed GLP-1 physiology award best combines a mature fundamental physiological advance with broad, durable, directly established therapeutic transformation in diabetes and obesity. Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker are a defensible limited allocation when the recognition is confined to enabling GLP-1 physiology rather than the wider distributed drug-development enterprise.
